results.name: header picture through the panel: the typed line is applied first, the picture becomes a locked 'picture' line, every page draws it, Undo / Redo move it on every page, and the saved file has it in the header part's own rels (python-docx sees the exact bytes)
refusals: an SVG and a PNG over 5 MB are refused with a visible reason; no picture is added and the document stays clean
modal shortcut: while a header line input has focus, Ctrl+Z is the input's own undo — the document's header picture and body stay
